headline: Congress takes a holiday week breather with only pro forma sessions ahead!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Tuesday afternoon, lasting just over half a minute before adjourning. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House held a brief session on Tuesday, introducing 22 bills and 6 resolutions while filing reports on veterans' benefits, tax administration, and education policies. The chamber adjourned after just three minutes with no votes recorded.
